notes.title: Para Bellum is already available in Early Access
notes.content:
[h1] Hello everyone [/h1]

We are pleased to announce that our game Para Bellum is already available in Early Access.
We look forward to your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802069/e7537947ea74945af132174ff8466e5f4db1373a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Changing release date to October 23
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone[/h1]

We want to inform you that the release date has changed.[b] The planned release date is October 23rd.[/b]

We received a lot of comments during the Steam Game Festival. After reviewing all of them, we came to the conclusion that some aspects of the game need to be improved.

Thanks!

notes.title: Fall Games Festival: Dev Stream
notes.content:
Join the developer stream [b]10 October in 17:00 on EEST.[/b] We will show several levels of the game, tell about its features and answer questions about the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802069/7984a61ec3a4aed6269dbfade2f80115244f5c8c.png[/img]

Also during the festival, we are planning to hold a keys giveaway on the official [url=https://discord.gg/CcRjzND]Discord[/url] channel. The game will be available after October 16. Subscribe to find out more.

Don't forget to set a reminder and add Para Bellum to your wishlist so you don't miss out on events.

notes.title: Fall Games Festival: Try the Demo
notes.content:
[h1] Hello everyone [/h1]

We are pleased to announce that our game Para Bellum is participating in the Fall Steam Games Festival. Join the stream with the developers [b]10 October in 17:00 by EEST[/b] We will show several levels of the game, tell about its features and answer questions about the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802069/7984a61ec3a4aed6269dbfade2f80115244f5c8c.png[/img]

You can try the [b]demo version of the game[/b], which includes two full levels. After going through the demo, you can get a general idea about the game.

We look forward to [b]productive communication with our community[/b] and we will be glad if you leave your feedback or ask a question about Para Bellum in the Steam community or in our [url=https://discord.gg/CcRjzND]Discord[/url]-channel.

Also during the festival, we are planning to hold a keys giveaway on the official [url=https://discord.gg/CcRjzND]Discord[/url] channel. The game will be available after October 16. Subscribe to find out more.

Don't forget to add Para Bellum to your wishlist so you don't miss the event.
